id: # Fungal benchmark panel — matches the fungi focus of the tool.
# Six genomes spanning Saccharomycotina (sce, cal, ylp), Pezizomycotina
# (ani, ncr), and Basidiomycota (cne). Curated reference annotations are
# available in SGD (sce), Candida Genome Database (cal), AspGD (ani),
# Multi-kingdom rows (plant, animal, insect, protist) were removed
# from this panel. The --kingdom support for non-fungal taxa remains
# in the codebase but is experimental and out of scope for this
# benchmark. If a future release validates multi-kingdom behaviour,
# add those rows back in a separate benchmark panel.
